title: Over 5,000 cops to secure Metro Manila for Nov. 23-24 transport strike

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 5,000 cops will be deployed across Metro Manila for the transport strike on Nov. 23-24 to ensure commuter safety, the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) said. Transport group Manibela and its allied groups will stage a strike over a potential change in the leadership of the Land Transportation Office (LTO).
